Booking.metaDescription: Send a ride request to ERVAIS in Kigali. He will contact you to confirm the details and agree the price.
Booking.title: Request a <accent>ride</accent>
Booking.intro: Tell ERVAIS about your trip. He will contact you by call or WhatsApp to confirm the details and agree the price.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: Rwandan numbers can be written as 078 123 4567. From abroad, start with + and your country code.

email.label: Email
email.hint: Only if you would like a confirmation by email.

notes.label: Notes
notes.hint: For example luggage, a child seat or your flight number.

Booking.notice: ERVAIS will contact you to confirm the details and agree the price. No online payment is required.
Booking.crossBorder: Cross-border trips are not offered. Trips must stay within Rwanda.
Booking.summaryTitle: Please fix the following to continue

errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.pastDateTime: This date and time have already passed. Choose a later time.
errors.tooFar: Choose a date within the next year.
errors.daysRange: Enter a number of days from {minDays} to {maxDays}.
errors.formExpired: This form has expired. Your answers are kept, so please send it again.
errors.tryAgain: Something went wrong. Please try sending again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests from your connection. Please wait a few minutes, or call or WhatsApp ERVAIS directly.
errors.serverError: We could not save your request. Please try again, or call or WhatsApp ERVAIS directly.

Received.title: Request <accent>received</accent>
Received.lead: Thank you. Your ride request has been sent to ERVAIS.
Received.keepCode: Keep this code in case you need to mention your request.
Received.contactText: ERVAIS will contact you by call or WhatsApp to confirm the details and agree the price.
Received.whatsappPrefill: Hello ERVAIS, my request reference is {ref}.
